httpWebhook.name: HTTP Webhook
httpWebhook.description: Send POST requests to a URL on certain events

mfa.name: Multi-Factor Authentication
mfa.description: Enable or disable passkeys and TOTP authentication

website.name: Website
website.description: Website related settings like title and description

environmentOverrides.title: Environment overrides
environmentOverrides.description: Some settings are managed by environment variables and cannot be changed here.

trustProxy.label: Trust Proxies
trustProxy.description: Trust X-Forwarded-* headers from the trusted proxies listed below. Requires a server restart.

trustedProxies.label: Trusted Proxies
trustedProxies.description: Enter the IPv4/IPv6 addresses or CIDRs of your reverse proxies, separated by commas. Only include trusted proxies, not client networks. An empty list ignores forwarded headers and shares rate limits across clients behind the same proxy. Requires a server restart.

defaultDomain.label: Default Domain
defaultDomain.description: The domain to use when generating URLs. This value should not include the protocol.

tempDirectory.label: Temporary Directory
tempDirectory.description: The directory to store temporary files. If the path is invalid, certain functions may break. Requires a server restart.

max.label: Max Chunk Size
max.description: Maximum size of an upload before it is split into chunks.

webhookUrl.label: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: The Discord webhook URL to send notifications to

username.label: Username
username.description: The username to send notifications as

webhookUrl.label: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: The Discord webhook URL to send notifications to. If this is left blank, the main webhook url will be used

username.label: Username
username.description: The username to send notifications as. If this is left blank, the main username will be used

avatarUrl.label: Avatar URL
avatarUrl.description: The avatar for the webhook. If this is left blank, the main avatar will be used

content.label: Content
content.description: The content of the notification. This can be blank, but at least one of the content or embed fields must be filled out

embed.label: Embed
embed.description: Send the notification as an embed. This will allow for more customization below.

thumbnail.label: Thumbnail
thumbnail.description: Show the thumbnail (it will show the file if it's an image) in the embed

imageOrVideo.label: Image/Video
imageOrVideo.description: Show the image or video in the embed

timestamp.label: Timestamp
timestamp.description: Show the timestamp in the embed

url.label: URL
url.description: Makes the title clickable and links to the URL of the file

imageCompression.label: Image Compression
imageCompression.description: Allows the ability for users to compress images.

robotsTxt.description: Enables a /robots.txt to stop search crawlers. Requires a server restart.

healthcheck.label: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Enables a healthcheck route for uptime monitoring. Requires a server restart.

userRegistration.label: User Registration
userRegistration.description: Allows users to register an account on the server.

oauthRegistration.label: OAuth Registration
oauthRegistration.description: Allows users to register an account using OAuth providers.

deleteOnMaxViews.label: Delete on Max Views
deleteOnMaxViews.description: Automatically deletes files/urls after they reach the maximum view count. Requires a server restart.

metricsEnabled.label: Enable Metrics
metricsEnabled.description: Enables metrics for the server. Requires a server restart.

metricsAdminOnly.label: Admin Only Metrics
metricsAdminOnly.description: Requires an administrator to view metrics.

metricsShowUserSpecific.label: Show User Specific Metrics
metricsShowUserSpecific.description: Shows metrics specific to each user, for all users.

thumbnailsEnabled.label: Enable Thumbnails
thumbnailsEnabled.description: Enables thumbnail generation for videos. Requires a server restart.

thumbnailsInstantaneous.label: Instantaneous Thumbnails
thumbnailsInstantaneous.description: Generates thumbnails immediately after a file is uploaded, instead of waiting for the task to run.

thumbnailsNumberThreads.label: Thumbnails Number Threads
thumbnailsNumberThreads.description: Number of threads to use for thumbnail generation, usually the number of CPU threads. Requires a server restart.

thumbnailsFormat.label: Thumbnails Format
thumbnailsFormat.description: The output format for thumbnails. Requires a server restart.

versionChecking.label: Version Checking
versionChecking.description: Query GitHub for updates and display the status on the sidebar to all users.

assumeMimetypes.label: Assume Mimetypes
assumeMimetypes.description: Assume the mimetype of a file for its extension.

disabledTypes.label: Disabled Types
disabledTypes.description: Mimetypes to disable, separated by commas. It is recommended to have the Assume Mimetypes setting enabled if you are disabling mimetypes, as this will also block files with the corresponding extensions.

disabledTypesDefault.label: Default MIME for Disabled Types
disabledTypesDefault.description: The default MIME type to use for disabled types. Leave blank to completely block disabled types.

extensionlessUrls.label: Extensionless URLs
extensionlessUrls.description: Allow file links without the extension (e.g. /u/uuid instead of /u/uuid.png). Upload responses still include the extension.

route.label: Route
route.description: The route to use for file uploads. Requires a server restart.

length.label: Length
length.description: The length of the file name (for randomly generated names).

defaultFormat.label: Default Format
defaultFormat.description: The default format to use for file names.

disabledExtensions.label: Disabled Extensions
disabledExtensions.description: Extensions to disable, separated by commas.

defaultDateFormat.label: Default Date Format
defaultDateFormat.description: The default date format to use.

defaultExpiration.label: Default Expiration
defaultExpiration.description: The default expiration time for files.

maxExpiration.label: Max Expiration
maxExpiration.description: The maximum expiration time allowed for files.

randomWordsNumAdjectives.label: Random Words Num Adjectives
randomWordsNumAdjectives.description: The number of adjectives to use for the random-words/gfycat format.

randomWordsSeparator.label: Random Words Separator
randomWordsSeparator.description: The separator to use for the random-words/gfycat format.

defaultCompressionFormat.label: Default Compression Format
defaultCompressionFormat.description: The default image compression format to use when only a compression percent is specified.

maxFilesPerUpload.label: Max Files Per Upload
maxFilesPerUpload.description: The maximum number of files allowed per upload. Requires a server restart.

onUpload.label: On Upload
onUpload.description: The URL to send a POST request to when a file is uploaded.

onShorten.label: On Shorten
onShorten.description: The URL to send a POST request to when a URL is shortened.

enabled.label: Enable Invites
enabled.description: Enable the use of invite links to register new users.

length.label: Length
length.description: The length of the invite code.

passkeysEnabled.label: Passkeys
passkeysEnabled.description: Enable the use of passwordless login with the use of WebAuthn passkeys like your phone, security keys, etc.

passkeysRpId.label: Relying Party ID
passkeysRpId.description: The Relying Party ID (RP ID) to use for WebAuthn passkeys.

passkeysOrigin.label: Origin
passkeysOrigin.description: The Origin to use for WebAuthn passkeys.

totpEnabled.label: Enable TOTP
totpEnabled.description: Enable Time-based One-Time Passwords with the use of an authenticator app.

totpIssuer.label: Issuer
totpIssuer.description: The issuer to use for the TOTP token.

oauth.intro: For OAuth to work, the "OAuth Registration" setting must be enabled in the <link>Features</link> section. If you have issues, try restarting Zipline after saving.

bypassLocalLogin.label: Bypass Local Login
bypassLocalLogin.description: Skips the local login page and redirects to the OAuth provider, this will only work with one provider enabled.

loginOnly.label: Login Only
loginOnly.description: Disables registration and only allows login with OAuth, existing users can link providers for example.

redirectUrl.label: {{provider}} Redirect URL
redirectUrl.description: The redirect URL to use instead of the host when logging in. This is not required if the URL generated by Zipline works as intended.

allowedIds.label: Discord Allowed IDs
allowedIds.description: A comma-separated list of Discord user IDs that are allowed to log in. Leave empty to disable allow list.

deniedIds.label: Discord Denied IDs
deniedIds.description: A comma-separated list of Discord user IDs that are denied from logging in. Leave empty to disable deny list.

pwa.intro: Refresh the page after enabling PWA to see any changes.

enabled.label: PWA Enabled
enabled.description: Allow users to install the Zipline PWA on their devices.

shortName.label: Short Name
shortName.description: The short name for the PWA

themeColor.label: Theme Color
themeColor.description: The theme color for the PWA

backgroundColor.label: Background Color
backgroundColor.description: The background color for the PWA

ratelimit.intro: All options require a restart to take effect.

adminBypass.label: Admin Bypass
adminBypass.description: Allow admins to bypass the ratelimit.

max.label: Max Requests
max.description: The maximum number of requests allowed within the window. If no window is set, this is the maximum number of requests until it reaches the limit.

window.label: Window
window.description: The window in seconds to allow the max requests.

allowList.label: Allow List
allowList.description: A comma-separated list of IP addresses to bypass the ratelimit.

tasks.intro: All options require a restart to take effect. Setting a value of 0 will disable the task.

deleteInterval.label: Delete Files Interval
deleteInterval.description: How often to check and delete expired files.

clearInvitesInterval.label: Clear Invites Interval
clearInvitesInterval.description: How often to check and clear expired/used invites.

maxViewsInterval.label: Max Views Interval
maxViewsInterval.description: How often to check and delete files that have reached max views.

thumbnailsInterval.label: Thumbnails Interval
thumbnailsInterval.description: How often to check and generate thumbnails for video files.

cleanThumbnailsInterval.label: Clean Thumbnails Interval
cleanThumbnailsInterval.description: How often to check and delete orphaned thumbnails from the filesystem or database.

metricsInterval.label: Metrics Interval
metricsInterval.description: How often to collect metrics data. Setting this to a lower value will give you more up-to-date metrics, but may increase CPU usage.

route.label: Route
route.description: The route to use for short URLs. Requires a server restart.

length.label: Length
length.description: The length of the short URL (for randomly generated names).

title.label: Title
title.description: The title of the website in browser tabs and at the top.

titleLogo.label: Title Logo
titleLogo.description: The URL to use for the title logo. This is placed to the left of the title.

externalLinks.label: External Links
externalLinks.description: The external links to show in the footer. This must be valid JSON in the format of an array of objects with "name" and "url" properties. For example: [{"name": "GitHub", "url": "https://github.com/diced/zipline"}]

loginBackground.label: Login Background
loginBackground.description: The URL to use for the login background.

loginBackgroundBlur.label: Login Background Blur
loginBackgroundBlur.description: Whether to blur the login background.

defaultAvatar.label: Default Avatar
defaultAvatar.description: The path to use for the default avatar. This must be a path to an image, not a URL.

tos.label: Terms of Service
tos.description: Path to a Markdown (.md) file to use for the terms of service.

defaultTheme.label: Default Theme
defaultTheme.description: The default theme to use for the website.

darkTheme.label: Dark Theme
darkTheme.description: The dark theme to use for the website when the default theme is "system".

lightTheme.label: Light Theme
lightTheme.description: The light theme to use for the website when the default theme is "system".
